scope: Actual sampled visual review of six final-candidate Wrigley still images from the third packaged build: day/night overview, field detail and route7 at50seconds. This is not a whole-movie motion review.

findings: Southwest overview clearly shows the red marquee, open ballpark, green stands, outfield boards and Gallagher lawn.
The foreground neighboring roof is part of the mapped context and does not obscure the main landmark.
White field illumination, restrained roof surfaces, red marquee and warm plaza remain balanced.
Both blue video boards now show bright readable lettering; the manual board is visible as a lit green face. No renewed broad glowing roof band.
Unobstructed view across the playing field toward the ivy wall, bleachers, manual scoreboard and two screens.
White field markings, grass and dirt are distinct. Screen lettering remains legible in daylight after the night-material refinement.
Both video boards now have luminous blue faces and clearly readable white WRIGLEY FIELD text.
Manual scoreboard rows and green face are visibly illuminated across the board rather than only two small corner spots. Its small individual labels remain limited by viewing distance.
Field coverage remains even; the scoreboard adjustment does not create a new foreground hotspot or roof glow.
Elevated route view shows the exposed seating bowl, irregular outfield, light frames and nearby Gallagher plaza.
The nearer roof naturally occupies part of the lower frame during this aerial approach; the open field and opposite stands remain visible. No camera collision or corrupted geometry is apparent.
Night route frame retains the lit field, readable board faces, white light frames and warm plaza edge.
Roof remains subdued, with localized light falloff rather than the earlier overexposed continuous band. No conspicuous clipping, corruption or obstructing object crosses the camera.

acceptance: The original night roof/field imbalance is corrected.
The later scoreboard/screen readability issue is corrected while preserving field illumination.
All six reviewed images show coherent geometry and clear intended framing without conspicuous corruption.
limits: The scene is an authored architectural interpretation, not a surveyed seat inventory, fixture schedule or current-game scoreboard.
Tiny manual-board labels are not individually readable from the wide field camera; the green face, clock and cell rows are visible.
Some night grain remains in dark surfaces in these96/128-sample stills. Motion stability, exported video compression and runtime performance require the root validation and media reviews.
Other North Side locations and full-duration routes are outside this six-image visual scope.
